lede: Everything Claude publishes about WalletWeather, in one place: reviews, what changed, and the iPhone app before and after each build. Pictures are from the simulator, on the demo's sample numbers.

pages.title: What changed for the iPhone UI review suite
pages.about: The source check, the simulator walk, the scripts and every file added on 24 November, with what the suite found on its first runs.

pages.title: The iPhone app, before and after
pages.about: Each TestFlight build beside the one before it: the screens that changed, side by side, with the changed part outlined.
pages.source: A script (apps/ios/Scripts/ui-before-after.py) writes it from the sets of pictures taken at each upload. Being built now.

pages.title: The iPhone app's UI review
pages.about: The latest review of the iPhone app: bugs, inconsistencies and design suggestions, each with a picture of today beside the proposal.
pages.source: /ios-ui-review writes it from a run of the source check and the simulator walk. The first one, on iOS 0.70.0, is being written now.

pages.title: Changelog
pages.about: What each release changed, newest first, with what's landed since the last one at the top.
pages.source: Would be written from CHANGELOG.md by a script, at each release and whenever an entry lands under Unreleased.

pages.title: Roadmap
pages.about: The ledger of ideas: what's done, what's planned and what's waiting, by its number.
pages.source: Would be written from ROADMAP.md by a script, with finished items struck through as they are there.

pages.title: Plans
pages.about: Every plan and where each of its phases stands: built, released, waiting on a check, or open.
pages.source: Would be written from the Status table at the top of each file in Plans/, with links to the phase issues.

pages.title: Decisions
pages.about: What's been decided and when, by subject: the choices behind the plans, with the options that were turned down.
pages.source: Would be written from the pages in docs/dev/decisions/: each page's title and its dated headings.

pages.title: Waiting on you
pages.about: What only you can do: checks to make on the phone, questions left open in a plan, and issues that wait for a look.
pages.source: Would be written from the checklist issue (#338), each plan's Open questions, and open issues, by a script that reads GitHub.

elsewhere.title: The iPhone app's design review
elsewhere.about: 27 findings and twelve ideas on iOS 0.34.0, each with today beside the proposal.
